testcase.name: Scenario: Preserve recent-document selections between list and grid views: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-home-recent-documents-source/features/application/home-recent-documents/home-recent-documents.feature:249:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Preserve recent-document selections between list and grid views ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And two recent parts are displayed in List View ✔ And the first part's row is checked ✔ When the user switches to Grid View ✔ Then the first part's card is checked and highlighted ✔ And Open Selected and Remove Selected are displayed ✔ When the user checks the second part's card ✔ And the user switches back to List View ✔ Then both parts' rows are checked and highlighted ✔ And Open Selected and Remove Selected remain displayed
